risk_summary: The excerpt reports sharply improved 2010 profitability and revenue, but its tone is tempered by extensive standard risk disclosures. Key risks include long and variable product cycles, customer and distributor concentration, reliance on third-party manufacturing, non-recurring licensing income, inventory hubbing, and significant accounting estimates. Several outcomes depend on management assumptions and customer behavior, limiting forward visibility.
